subject: CURRENT-HEAD FINDING: opening visual can outrun async INNER wake; normal handoff can invalidate queued wake
body: Bounded current-head source finding against main 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64, extending the human FIELD-DELTA without claiming a third ticket. Exact ordering is source-confirmed. DeviceState path: FoldOverlayService calls continuity.onEarlyOpeningEdge(); the controller transitions NATIVE_COVER -> OPENING_FROM_CLOSED and emits WakeInner(generation G); coordinator.apply() calls wakeInner(G), which only queues Dispatchers.IO and rechecks controller generation inside the worker; control immediately returns to FoldOverlayService, which calls gen3Visual.beginOpening(G). Gen3 beginOpening synchronously creates opening movement/content and sets visibleDemand=true before the privileged wake worker is guaranteed to have started. Hinge path has the same ordering. In addition, controller.transition() increments generation on every state transition; normal OPENING_FROM_CLOSED -> INNER_HANDOFF at innerActive OR >=8 deg increments G->G+1. If the queued IO worker starts after that normal progression, its second isGenerationCurrent(G) check returns false and the required wake is dropped. Therefore current main admits an exact schedule where cover/front opening animation starts while no INNER physical wake Binder call has yet occurred, and can then suppress that wake entirely during normal handoff. This revalidates the older async-effect-lifetime defect on current main and is directly compatible with the human observation of animation beginning while INNER remains dark. Separate downstream gap remains: even a successful WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY receipt proves only SurfaceControl.setDisplayPowerMode(token,2), not logical INNER readiness or first useful pixels. Recommended review target: restore a semantic openingAttemptId/wake-intent lifetime spanning OPENING_FROM_CLOSED -> INNER_HANDOFF and revoked only on true cancellation/inner-active; one-shot commit immediately before shell mutation; make opening visual admission depend at minimum on WAKE_COMMITTED (privileged call actually dispatched/accepted), while final visual/native handoff remains presentation-gated by same-attempt INNER readiness/useful-frame evidence. Consider a dedicated low-jitter wake executor instead of generic Dispatchers.IO after correctness is fixed. Physical Fold7 causality still requires attempt-correlated field telemetry; no production write made.
